title: Agent Readiness Auditor input
description: Provide the list of websites to audit for AI-agent readiness. Each site is fetched (homepage + robots.txt + llms.txt + agents.md + sitemap.xml) and scored 0-100.

websites.title: Websites to audit
websites.description: Website URLs to audit, one per line. The scheme is optional — 'example.com' is treated as 'https://example.com'. Private/local addresses are rejected.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many websites to audit in parallel. Each audit makes 5 lightweight HTTP requests.

fetchTimeoutSecs.title: Fetch timeout (seconds)
fetchTimeoutSecs.description: Per-request timeout. Slow sites that exceed it are reported as unreachable (and not charged).

userAgent.title: User-Agent override
userAgent.description: Optional custom User-Agent header sent with every request. Leave empty for the default AgentReadinessAuditor UA.
userAgent.sectionDescription: Options most runs never need to touch.
